experiment: Phase 29 Molecular Networking Chemical Scaffold Homology Benchmark
dataset: 250 timsTOF Natural Products (Row Group 20 enveda-np-examples, 31,125 pairs)
chemical_findings: At tau = 0.60, k = 6: Only 15.3% of pairs share an identical Murcko scaffold and 23.6% share an aglycone core. 76.4% are distinct scaffolds.
Unconstrained networking at tau = 0.60 introduces 76-85% false positive graph edges, which demoted true Rank 1 leaders in V31 (0.1400 LB score).
Tightening tau to >= 0.70 elevates scaffold homology to 41.7% and mean Tanimoto to 0.523.
Strict Rank-1 Shield (w_top = 0.00) and restricting propagation strictly to ranks 2-25 prevents leader disruption while clustering true aglycone analogs.
